'''Cov''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and a veteran of many battles. He claimed descent from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Kadlo]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], and when the [[Kadlo Talisman]], an artifact from Kadlo's reign, was looted from a [[Burial/Legends|tomb]], Cov was told by an informant that it had been spotted in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] and hired several individuals to locate it. They found the talisman in the possession of several of Cov's mutinous crewmen, who had been bought out by [[DurAble]], a corporation whose interests lay contrary to Cov's.<ref name="CatCW" />
